parameters.jsCode:
const requiredJson = '{"intent":"greeting|faq|billing|technical_issue|human_request|legal_security|data_deletion|unknown","answer":"string|null","confidence":0.0,"needs_human":false,"risk_flags":[],"knowledge_used":[],"labels":[],"private_summary":"string"}';
const agentPrompt = [
  'Return ONLY valid JSON matching this contract:', requiredJson,
  '', 'You own intent classification and knowledge selection.',
  'Choose relevant knowledge ids in knowledge_used. Use [] when none applies.',
  '', 'Latest customer message:', $json.userText,
  '', 'Guardrail risk flags:', JSON.stringify($json.guardrailRiskFlags || []),
  'Context failed:', String($json.contextFailed),
  '', 'Recent transcript:', $json.transcript || '(empty)',
  '', 'Conversation labels:', JSON.stringify($json.labels || []),
  'Conversation custom attributes:', JSON.stringify($json.customAttributes || {}),
  'Conversation additional attributes:', JSON.stringify($json.additionalAttributes || {}),
  '', 'Knowledge pack:', $json.knowledgeContext,
  '', 'Tool context:', JSON.stringify($json.toolContext || {})
].join('\n');
return [{ json: { ...$json, agentPrompt } }];

options.systemMessage: You are a customer support AI Agent. Classify intent, select relevant knowledge_used ids from the supplied knowledge pack, and answer only from transcript, knowledge, and tool context. If user requests a human or policy risk exists, set needs_human true. If the question is unknown and no knowledge applies, set intent unknown, confidence low, and needs_human true. Greetings/small talk can be answered briefly without knowledge_used. Keep answer under 1200 chars. Risk flags allowed: refund, billing_dispute, legal, security, data_deletion, angry_customer, human_requested, credential_shared, tool_failed, unknown. Return only JSON.
